title: ROPA30 - common definitions
description: Shared types of the ROPA30 data specification: bilingual texts, dates and code lists. Codes are stored as language-neutral identifiers; their human-readable labels are provided by the application in each language and are never stored in the data.

bilingualText.title: Bilingual text
bilingualText.description: Free text in Italian and English. Either language may be empty: the register may be kept in one language only, and no automatic translation is performed.

dateTime.title: Date and time
dateTime.description: ISO 8601 date and time with time zone (RFC 3339), e.g. 2026-11-24T18:30:00.000Z.

registerType.title: Type of record
registerType.description: Which record the entry belongs to.

oneOf.description: Art. 6(1)(b): performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps.
Art. 6(1)(c): compliance with a legal obligation.
Art. 6(1)(e): public interest or exercise of official authority.

conditionArt9.title: Condition for special categories of data (GDPR Art. 9(2))

oneOf.description: Art. 9(2)(b): employment, social security and social protection law.
Art. 9(2)(e): data manifestly made public by the data subject.
Art. 9(2)(f): legal claims or courts acting in their judicial capacity.
Art. 9(2)(h): preventive or occupational medicine, health or social care.
Art. 9(2)(i): public interest in the area of public health.
Art. 9(2)(j): archiving, scientific or historical research, statistics.

transferSafeguard.title: Safeguard for a transfer to a third country or international organisation (GDPR Chapter V)

oneOf.description: Art. 46(2)(c) and (d): standard data protection clauses.
Art. 46(2)(b) and Art. 47: binding corporate rules.
Not yet determined: to be verified (ROPA30 working value).
Collected from the data subject (cf. Art. 13).
Not collected from the data subject (cf. Art. 14).

dataSourceStored.title: Source of the personal data, as stored
dataSourceStored.description: Current values, plus legacy values that may still be found in records created by earlier versions. Legacy values are never written by the current application and are never rewritten automatically.

anyOf.description: Legacy value (directly from the data subject). Replaced by 'interessato' or 'misto'.

finalAction.title: Action at the end of the retention period

oneOf.description: An item, or the whole database, was deleted.
The whole database was replaced by a backup.

auditActionStored.title: Audit action, as stored
auditActionStored.description: Current values, plus legacy values written by earlier versions. The audit log is never rewritten, so legacy values remain valid in historical entries.

xGdpr.$comment: Meta-description of the x-gdpr annotation used in this specification (documentation only; not applied to data).
